units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 64a:6">Snh. 64ᵃ</cite> <he>כג׳ דנורא</he> fire in the form of a young lion.—Pl. <cite ref="C00495"><he>גּוּרְיִין</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 95a:15">Ib. 95ᵃ</cite> (play on <cite ref="B00765"><he>בֵּיתְרִי</he></cite> q. v.) when they came to Bethré, they said <he>בין תרי ג׳ קטלין א׳</he> (read <he>קטלן</he>) Ms. M. (ed. <he>בתרי ג׳ קטלוה לאריא</he>, read <he>בי תרי</he> a. <he>קטלן</he>) between (us) two cubs (David and Abishai)—can we kill the lion (Goliath)?
